freepd.name: FreePD.com (Kevin MacLeod and contributors)
freepd.license_statement: This music is all licensed CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication. (FreePD.com home page, Legal section)
freepd.notes: freepd.com closed in 2025 (the site now only shows a shutdown notice), so files are fetched from the Wayback Machine capture of the original https://freepd.com/music/<title>.mp3 URL; archive.org item 'freepd' (third-party mirror, only used when its md5 equals the Wayback file) is the second URL. Wayback can be slow (up to minutes per file) and occasionally rate-limits: the fetch script retries the next URL and can simply be rerun.
